episodes.synopsis: On a cold winter's day, Cuff arrives at the mansion with a magic item that can summon a swimming pool from out of nowhere.
episodes.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Magic Pool

episodes.synopsis: Alice and the Duke play a game of mini-golf while receiving an unexpected visitor.
episodes.title: The Duke, Golf, and the Mysterious Beauty

episodes.synopsis: The Duke and Alice receive two visitors: a ghost, and a woman who says she can break the curse.
episodes.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Spectral Bride

episodes.synopsis: The Duke and Alice join the circus as the Duke prepares to talk to Zain.
episodes.title: The Duke, Alice, and Circus 101

episodes.synopsis: Zain decides it's time to leave Gemini Circus, but wants to confess his feelings to Cuff before he goes.
episodes.title: Cuff, Zain, and the Confession

episodes.synopsis: The Duke and Alice return to the mansion, bearing gifts from Circus Gemini. Cuff and Zain go out for their first date, but get caught out in the rain.
episodes.title: The Duke and Everyone's Daily Life

episodes.synopsis: Walter, Alice, and the Duke head to the Witches' World to find out more about the curse. Walter has an unexpected encounter.
episodes.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Encounter in the Witches' World

episodes.synopsis: Walter, Alice, and the Duke learn more about the Duke's curse, and the Duke gets a lamp that can grant any wish.
episodes.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Kissing Window

episodes.synopsis: It's been two years since Alice came to the mansion, and the Duke wants to do something special for her.
episodes.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Second Anniversary

episodes.synopsis: Alice gets a flying broom, and the Duke gets a pair of unusual visitors with a shocking offer.
episodes.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Flying Broom

episodes.synopsis: The Duke and all his friends head off to the wizardry school, and Daleth follows as well.
episodes.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Wizardry School

episodes.synopsis: Zain takes the crew back in time to confront Sade in the past.
episodes.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Curse Witch
